title: In from the Night
overview: Vicki Miller is a writer who has cut herself off from her dysfunctional family. Her life drastically changes when one night, her 16-year-old nephew Bobby shows up unannounced on her doorstep. He looks tired and depressed, and when Vicki realizes that he's run away, she takes him in.

file.itemTitle: BOOTLEGGER'S DRIVE-IN SATURDAY NIGHT: THE BEAST FROM HAUNTED CAVE & A BUCKET OF BLOOD
